author: GoPro
description:
From Everest Camp 4 to the top of the world 🏔️ Mountaineer @RyanMitchellYT documented his final push to the 29,032ft (8,848m) summit of Mt. Everest alongside Garret Madison and his Sherpa team. Clipped into fixed ropes, weaving past other climbers, and moving deliberately through the death zone, Ryan captured every breath and step on his GoPro. Using supplemental oxygen, he advanced steadily across steep ice, exposed ridgelines, and bottleneck sections where patience and precision matter as much as strength.

Everest remains the ultimate test of endurance, altitude, and resolve. This ascent shows the modern reality of climbing the world's tallest peak in extreme cold and relentless elevation.
